svg.title: Otterwater Reach — Otter rescue boathouse
svg.desc: Boathouse shelves overlook three calm pools. Floating logs form an optional low route; a fixed bank walk and rescue ropes keep the escort safe. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.
svg.text: Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 11–15

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Boathouse shelves overlook three calm pools. Floating logs form an optional low route; a
fixed bank walk and rescue ropes keep the escort safe.
6 raised landings · 2 stairs · 2 ropes · 2 ladders · 22 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Brookskip Otter · Benevolent / Common; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
